fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Strikes for 20 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Fixed Quarry
fusions.desc: Each weapon strike gives your next strike +15% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
